''See also: [[the Angler of the Crystal Halls Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Angler of the [[Crystal Halls]], also known as [[Iri]], is a powerful and self-interested collector who resides in a massive palace carved from a single diamond. Her home, the [[Crystal Halls]], is a magnificent structure of blue crystal that serves as both her residence and a repository for her vast treasures. She is characterized by her desire to acquire valuable artifacts, often acting more as a collector than a liberator. Her reputation includes stealing several weapons from [[Abidan]] [[Iterations]], including twelve prototype scythes forged by [[Makiel]]. She has also been known to acquire unique items through trade, such as an invisibility cloak she personally wove during her time as a mortal. In terms of power and temperament, the Angler is described as being comparable to a rival of Zakariel{{!}}Zakariel the Fox. She has demonstrated the ability to use ancient artifacts and her own Authority{{!}}authority to manipulate the spatial properties of objects. During conflicts, she has used the chaos of battle to attempt thefts, such as stealing a horn from a [[dragon]] within the [[Heartbeat Star]], though she has been intercepted by [[Telariel]]. She is noted for her unpredictable nature and her tendency to evade the search efforts of the spiders{{!}}Spiders by using her vessel's presence to navigate randomly through different [[Iterations]].}}

== Uncrowned ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-07-uncrowned|The Angler of the [[Crystal Halls]] is a target located within [[Iteration]] 002 [[Haven]] that [[Makiel]] is actively hunting. As an enemy of the [[Abidan]], this entity is potentially responsible for the elimination of [[Iteration 943]]. The Angler wields a black scythe created from an artful blend of twelve prototype weapons forged by [[Makiel]]. Despite its history, the entity is considered predictable, [[safe]], and entirely self-interested.}}
